prompt: Is PR 42 merged and are its current checks green?
must: select live repository state as source of truth
inspect current PR/check state
must_not: use a readiness analyzer as repository source

prompt: The lockfile shows framework version X. Confirm the current documented API behavior for that exact version.
must: establish local version first
select current documentation authority

prompt: The preferred reviewer is unavailable. Continue safely.
must: keep nominal and selected owner distinct
choose a callable independent fallback or record a review evidence gap
must_not: count non-execution as a passed review

prompt: Use an installed tool whose name is visible but whose callable contract is unknown.
must: resolve current capability contract before use

prompt: Two coding tools can both edit the same files. Implement the accepted bounded change.
must: select one write owner for the file surface
use other tools only in non-conflicting roles
must_not: let both edit the same mutable surface concurrently

prompt: A reviewer says the change looks correct, but tests were not run.
must: keep work in verifying or partially verified state
seek executable proof
must_not: treat review agreement as executable proof

prompt: Repair an open PR that already has bot reviews and inline threads.
must: inspect current head
consume top-level comments, reviews, inline threads, checks, and bot context
classify stale versus current findings
must_not: ignore bot output because it is automated

prompt: The PR was approved and ready, then a new commit was pushed. Merge it.
must: invalidate old-head readiness
refresh checks and review context for the new head

prompt: Here is a PR evidence packet. Judge only the supplied material for readiness.
must: use supplied-evidence readiness analysis

prompt: Here is an Issue body. Extract confirmed requirements, unknowns, tests, and risks.
must: treat supplied material as the evidence boundary

prompt: Run a finite local suite that may take several minutes, but no long-process runner is callable.
must: execute foreground only if the host supports same-turn execution or record an execution evidence gap
must_not: claim the suite ran when it did not

prompt: Ask every installed review bot to review this trivial one-line change.
must: choose at most one primary independent reviewer by default
must_not: trigger all reviewers merely because they are installed

prompt: Continue the repo work from an old handoff; several commits may have landed since.
must: inspect live state first
reconcile handoff with current reality
preserve completed work
must_not: treat handoff prose as current truth

prompt: Turn a long personal workflow handbook into a portable Agent Skill with routing and evals.
must: separate stable routing rules from runtime availability
use progressive disclosure
label eval corpus separately from executed benchmark
must_not: copy session-specific availability as permanent truth

prompt: Take a verified PR through final landing.
must: bind landing decision to current exact head
select one landing owner
confirm landing receipt or explicit blocker
must_not: treat queue submission as merge completion
